words.enDefinition: A university facility for recreational exercise, sports, or other activities.

examples.en: We stopped at the campus recreation center before our evening class to look around.
examples.zh: 我们在上晚课前顺路去了「校园文体活动中心」，在里面转了转。

examples.en: My roommate works at the campus recreation center between her morning and afternoon lectures.
examples.zh: 室友在上午课和下午课之间到「校园文体活动中心」打工。

collocations: a class at the campus recreation center

words.enDefinition: The main exercise area of a gym where equipment is laid out for use.

examples.en: A staff member showed us the fitness floor after we checked in downstairs together.
examples.zh: 我们在楼下一起签到后，工作人员带我们看了「健身器械区」。

examples.en: The fitness floor was quieter at lunchtime than it had been after our lectures.
examples.zh: 「健身器械区」在午饭时间比我们下课后去的时候安静。

collocations: a map of the fitness floor

words.enDefinition: A gym room equipped for exercise using weights and strength machines.

examples.en: The weight room was at the end of the corridor past the changing rooms.
examples.zh: 更衣室过去，走廊尽头就是「力量训练室」。

examples.en: I found a map of the weight room beside the water station upstairs today.
examples.zh: 我今天在楼上的饮水处旁找到了「力量训练室」的地图。

words.enDefinition: The part of a gym set aside for weights that are not attached to machines.

examples.en: The floor plan marked the free-weight area separately from the machines near the windows.
examples.zh: 平面图把「自由重量区」和窗边的固定器械分开标出。

examples.en: My roommate asked which sign pointed to the free-weight area when we toured the gym.
examples.zh: 我们参观健身房时，室友问哪块牌子指向「自由重量区」。

collocations: a sign for the free-weight area

words.enDefinition: The part of a gym with equipment for cardiovascular exercise.

examples.en: We found the cardio area upstairs after passing the desk beside the main entrance.
examples.zh: 经过正门旁的服务台后，我们在楼上找到了「有氧器械区」。

examples.en: The gym moved its cardio area to the side of the room with more windows.
examples.zh: 健身房把「有氧器械区」挪到了房间窗户更多的那一侧。

collocations: a map of the cardio area

words.enDefinition: A space set aside for people to stretch in a gym or studio.

examples.en: The stretching area had floor mats lined up on a shelf beside the mirror.
examples.zh: 「拉伸区」的镜子旁有个架子，上面整齐摆着垫子。

examples.en: Our guide pointed out the stretching area after we walked past the row of bikes.
examples.zh: 经过那一排健身车后，向导指给我们看「拉伸区」。

words.enDefinition: A room in a fitness facility where organized exercise classes are held.

examples.en: Our instructor met us outside the group fitness studio before the room was unlocked.
examples.zh: 房间开锁前，教练在「团课教室」外和我们碰头。

examples.en: The map showed the group fitness studio next to the stairs on the second floor.
examples.zh: 地图显示，「团课教室」就在二楼楼梯旁。

collocations: meet outside the group fitness studio
classes in the group fitness studio

words.enDefinition: A track inside a building for people to walk or run on.

examples.en: We met beside the indoor track to see whether it was open during lunch.
examples.zh: 我们在「室内跑道」旁碰头，看看午饭时间这里开不开放。

examples.en: The campus gym's indoor track was visible from the seating area near the stairs.
examples.zh: 从楼梯旁的座位区，可以看到校园健身房的「室内跑道」。

words.enDefinition: A staff member who oversees a gym area and answers basic questions about the space.

examples.en: I asked the fitness attendant where the next equipment tour would start that morning.
examples.zh: 我问「健身区值班员」，当天上午下一场器械参观从哪儿开始。

examples.en: The fitness attendant set out a notice while we waited for our classmates to arrive.
examples.zh: 我们等同学过来时，「健身区值班员」摆了一块告示牌。

words.enDefinition: An introductory session explaining a gym's spaces, services, and expectations for use.

examples.en: We signed up for a gym orientation because neither of us knew the layout.
examples.zh: 我俩都不了解里面的布局，所以报名参加了「健身房入门介绍」。

examples.en: My first gym orientation included a short tour and a chance to ask questions.
examples.zh: 我第一次参加「健身房入门介绍」，有简短的参观环节，也可以提问。

collocations: sign up for a gym orientation
a gym orientation for new students

words.enDefinition: The step of confirming your arrival before entering a gym.

examples.en: The gym check-in desk moved to the other side of the lobby during maintenance.
examples.zh: 维修期间，「健身房入场登记」服务台搬到了大厅另一侧。

examples.en: I finished gym check-in while my roommate looked for the schedule by the entrance.
examples.zh: 我完成「健身房入场登记」时，室友在入口附近找时间表。

words.enDefinition: Scheduled times when people can use the gym for independent recreation.

examples.en: I checked open gym hours because the room was sometimes reserved for classes and events.
examples.zh: 这个房间有时会被留给课程和活动，所以我查了「健身房自由活动时段」。

examples.en: Our friends met during open gym hours after the last instructed session had finished.
examples.zh: 最后一场教练带领的课程结束后，朋友们在「健身房自由活动时段」碰了面。

collocations: a sign listing open gym hours

words.enDefinition: The times when a gym tends to have the most visitors.

examples.en: The student guide listed peak gym hours based on when the campus center was busiest.
examples.zh: 学生指南根据校园中心最繁忙的时间列出了「健身房高峰时段」。

examples.en: We met for coffee first because we had arrived during peak gym hours that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚到的时候正值「健身房高峰时段」，我们就先碰面喝了杯咖啡。

collocations: a notice about peak gym hours

words.enDefinition: Whether particular equipment is free and available to use at a given time.

examples.en: The front desk display showed equipment availability while we waited to start our session.
examples.zh: 等着开始运动时，前台的屏幕显示了「器械空闲情况」。

examples.en: I checked equipment availability because the bikes were all occupied on my previous visit.
examples.zh: 因为上次来时健身车全被占用了，我先查了「器械空闲情况」。

words.enDefinition: A question asking whether a piece of equipment or a space is currently being used.

examples.en: I asked “Is anyone using this?” when I found a bottle beside the bench.
examples.zh: 我发现训练凳旁放着一个瓶子，就问「这个有人在用吗」？

examples.en: “Is anyone using this?” she asked about the mat beside the studio door today.
examples.zh: 她指着团课教室门边的垫子问「这个有人在用吗」？

collocations: check by asking is anyone using this

words.enDefinition: To take turns using the same exercise station during another person's breaks.

examples.en: I asked if I could work in because my classmate was already at the machine.
examples.zh: 同学已经在用那台器械，我就问能不能「和对方轮流用」。

examples.en: The notice explained what it meant to work in at the busier gym stations.
examples.zh: 告示解释了在比较繁忙的健身器械点位怎样算「与别人轮流用器械」。

words.expression: how many sets do you have left
words.lemma: how many sets do you have left
words.enDefinition: A gym question asking how much of a person's exercise at a station remains.
acceptedEnVariants: how many sets do you have left

examples.en: I asked “How many sets do you have left?” while waiting beside the weight bench.
examples.zh: 我在训练凳旁等时问了句「你还剩几组」？

examples.en: “How many sets do you have left?” my roommate asked after the busy class finished.
examples.zh: 人很多的那节课结束后，室友问「你还剩几组」？

collocations: ask how many sets do you have left
say how many sets do you have left
ask politely how many sets do you have left

words.enDefinition: To return loose weights to their proper rack after they have been used.

examples.en: The fitness attendant held up a card asking students to re-rack weights after use.
examples.zh: 健身区值班员举起一张卡片，请同学们用完后「把重量器材放回架上」。

examples.en: Our gym had signs to re-rack weights at both ends of the long mirror.
examples.zh: 我们健身房那面长镜子的两头都贴着「把重量器材放回架上」的告示。

words.enDefinition: Disposable wet cloths supplied for cleaning shared surfaces and equipment.

examples.en: The staff member replaced a container of disinfecting wipes near the end of our session.
examples.zh: 我们快练完的时候，工作人员换了一桶「消毒湿巾」。

examples.en: I noticed the disinfecting wipes beside the door after our group class had ended.
examples.zh: 团课结束后，我留意到门边有「消毒湿巾」。

words.enDefinition: A reminder to clean the equipment surface when you finish using it.

examples.en: A sign beside the bikes said “Wipe the equipment after use” below a picture.
examples.zh: 健身车旁的告示在一张图片下写着「用完擦拭器械」。

examples.en: The orientation leaflet reminded students to wipe the equipment after use in the shared room.
examples.zh: 入门介绍传单提醒同学们，在公共训练室要「用完擦拭器械」。

collocations: a sign reading wipe the equipment after use
ask users to wipe the equipment after use
remember to wipe the equipment after use

words.enDefinition: A small open compartment in a gym where visitors can put belongings.

examples.en: My roommate found an empty gym cubby for her bag near the studio door.
examples.zh: 室友在团课教室门旁找到了一个空的「健身房开放储物格」放包。

examples.en: A number on each gym cubby helped everyone find their shoes after class ended.
examples.zh: 每个「健身房开放储物格」都有编号，方便大家下课后找鞋。

collocations: put a bag in a gym cubby

words.enDefinition: A service through which a facility supplies towels for visitors to use.

examples.en: We asked about towel service after noticing the stack of clean towels near reception.
examples.zh: 看到前台附近叠着一摞干净毛巾后，我们问了问「毛巾供应服务」。

examples.en: A notice about towel service was posted beside the entrance to the changing area.
examples.zh: 更衣区入口旁贴着一则「毛巾供应服务」告示。

words.enDefinition: A facility notice asking visitors to provide a towel for their own use.

examples.en: The room description said “Bring your own towel” beside the list of items provided.
examples.zh: 房间说明在已提供的物品清单旁写着「请自带毛巾」。

examples.en: I saw “Bring your own towel” on the studio door before our first class.
examples.zh: 第一次上课前，我在团课教室门上看到了「请自带毛巾」。

collocations: a sign saying bring your own towel
a notice reading bring your own towel
ask guests to bring their own towel

words.enDefinition: Shoes with soles designed to avoid leaving marks on a floor.

examples.en: The notice for the new studio asked for non-marking shoes on the wooden floor.
examples.zh: 新教室的告示要求，在木地板上穿「不留鞋痕的鞋」。

examples.en: I asked the attendant what counted as non-marking shoes before joining the dance class.
examples.zh: 去上舞蹈课之前，我问值班员什么样的鞋算「不留鞋痕的鞋」。

words.enDefinition: A sign stating that only footwear reserved for indoor use is allowed in an area.

examples.en: A small notice saying “Indoor shoes only” was posted beside the entrance to the studio.
examples.zh: 团课教室入口旁贴着一张小告示，写着「仅限室内用鞋」。

examples.en: I saw “Indoor shoes only” on the door while waiting for our instructor to arrive.
examples.zh: 等教练来时，我看到门上写着「仅限室内用鞋」。

collocations: a sign saying indoor shoes only
a room marked indoor shoes only
a notice reading indoor shoes only

words.enDefinition: Shoes intended for exercise that cover the toes.

examples.en: Our recreation center's poster listed closed-toe athletic shoes for entry to the main gym area.
examples.zh: 校园文体中心的海报写着，进主健身区要穿「包脚趾的运动鞋」。

examples.en: I asked whether my usual closed-toe athletic shoes were allowed in the new studio.
examples.zh: 我问平时穿的「包脚趾的运动鞋」能不能穿进新开的团课教室。

collocations: a rule about closed-toe athletic shoes

words.enDefinition: The maximum amount of time visitors may use a particular machine when a limit applies.

examples.en: The sign explained when the equipment time limit applied to the bikes near the window.
examples.zh: 告示解释了窗边健身车的「单次使用器械的时限」在什么情况下适用。

examples.en: We asked about the equipment time limit because several people were waiting for a treadmill.
examples.zh: 有几个人正在等跑步机，所以我们问了问「单次使用器械的时限」。

collocations: a notice about the equipment time limit

words.enDefinition: A label indicating that someone is using a piece of equipment at the moment.

examples.en: The little display read “Equipment in use” while my classmate finished at the machine.
examples.zh: 同学还没用完那台机器，小屏幕上显示「器械使用中」。

examples.en: I saw “Equipment in use” next to the bike I had been waiting for.
examples.zh: 我看到自己一直在等的那台健身车旁显示「器械使用中」。

collocations: a sign reading equipment in use
a status marked equipment in use

words.enDefinition: To tell staff when shared exercise equipment is damaged or visibly unsafe to use.

examples.en: The staff showed our orientation group where to report damaged equipment after the tour.
examples.zh: 参观结束后，工作人员告诉我们新生小组到哪里「报告器械损坏」。

examples.en: The notice beside the desk asked visitors to report damaged equipment to the attendant.
examples.zh: 服务台旁的告示请来访者向值班员「报告器械损坏」。

collocations: ask visitors to report damaged equipment
a reminder to report damaged equipment
show where to report damaged equipment

words.enDefinition: Rules established by a particular gym for the people using it.

examples.en: I read the gym rules while waiting for my roommate to finish checking in.
examples.zh: 等室友完成入场登记时，我看了看「健身房使用规定」。

examples.en: The gym rules were posted next to the floor map in the main lobby.
examples.zh: 「健身房使用规定」就贴在主大厅的楼层图旁。

words.enDefinition: A container where visitors leave towels they have finished using.

examples.en: I walked past the used towel bin on the way out of the cycling studio.
examples.zh: 我离开骑行教室时经过了「用过的毛巾回收桶」。

examples.en: A staff member moved the used towel bin closer to the changing room entrance.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「用过的毛巾回收桶」挪得离更衣室入口更近了。

collocations: put towels in the used towel bin
a sign for the used towel bin

words.enDefinition: Gym machines intended for exercises such as indoor cycling, walking, or rowing.

examples.en: The building map showed most of the cardio equipment along the wall by the windows.
examples.zh: 楼宇地图显示，大部分「有氧运动器械」沿着窗边的一面墙摆放。

examples.en: We passed the cardio equipment on our way to ask about the group classes.
examples.zh: 我们去问团课的路上经过了「有氧运动器械」。

words.enDefinition: An exercise machine with a moving belt that a person can walk or run on.

examples.en: The first treadmill by the window had a sign saying it was being checked.
examples.zh: 窗边第一台「跑步机」上贴了牌子，写着正在检查。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the treadmill beside the stairs was included on the tour.
examples.zh: 室友问参观会不会介绍楼梯旁的「跑步机」。

words.enDefinition: A stationary machine with pedals that move along an oval path during exercise.

examples.en: The guide pointed out an elliptical trainer between the bikes and the rowing machines.
examples.zh: 向导指给我们看健身车和划船机之间的一台「椭圆机」。

examples.en: I recognized the elliptical trainer from the photograph on the gym's website before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我根据健身房网站上的照片认出了「椭圆机」。

words.enDefinition: A bicycle-like exercise machine designed to stay in one place while a person pedals.

examples.en: The stationary bike nearest the door had a display with several different language options.
examples.zh: 离门最近的那台「固定式健身车」屏幕上有几种语言选项。

examples.en: My classmate recognized a stationary bike like the one in her old residence hall.
examples.zh: 同学认出了一台「固定式健身车」，跟她以前宿舍楼里的很像。

collocations: a stationary bike in the studio

words.enDefinition: A stationary exercise bike with a backrest and a seat set in a reclined position.

examples.en: The recreation center put a recumbent bike next to the upright bikes by the mirror.
examples.zh: 文体活动中心把一台「卧式健身车」摆在镜子旁的直立式健身车旁边。

examples.en: A student asked the attendant to identify the recumbent bike shown on the map.
examples.zh: 一名同学请值班员指出地图上哪台是「卧式健身车」。

collocations: a recumbent bike with a backrest
a row with a recumbent bike

words.enDefinition: A stationary exercise machine that imitates much of the movement of rowing a boat.

examples.en: The rowing machine was by the entrance, just across from the shelf for towels.
examples.zh: 「划船机」在入口旁，正对着放毛巾的架子。

examples.en: My classmate drew a rowing machine on the map so our group could recognize it.
examples.zh: 同学在地图上画了一台「划船机」，方便小组其他人认出来。

words.enDefinition: A machine that provides exercise using moving steps or pedals that imitate climbing stairs.

examples.en: The stair climber was easy to recognize because it looked like a short moving staircase.
examples.zh: 「登阶机」很容易认，因为看起来像一小段会动的楼梯。

examples.en: We saw a notice about the stair climber while waiting for the tour to start.
examples.zh: 我们在等参观开始时，看到了一则关于「登阶机」的告示。

words.enDefinition: A piece of gym equipment with mechanical resistance, usually created by moving weights.

examples.en: I asked the attendant to identify the weight machine with the blue seat near reception.
examples.zh: 我请值班员告诉我，前台附近那台蓝色座椅的是什么「力量训练器械」。

examples.en: A student looked at the label on the weight machine before asking a staff member.
examples.zh: 一位同学先看了「力量训练器械」上的标签，随后去问工作人员。

collocations: a weight machine on the gym floor

words.enDefinition: A gym machine that transfers resistance through a cable and pulley system.

examples.en: The tour paused beside a cable machine while students asked about the labels on it.
examples.zh: 参观时我们在一台「绳索训练器械」旁停下来，同学们问了上面的标签。

examples.en: There were several empty stations around the cable machine before the afternoon class began.
examples.zh: 下午课开始前，「绳索训练器械」周围还有几个空的训练位。

collocations: a handle on the cable machine
a label beside the cable machine

words.enDefinition: The series of stacked weights that provides resistance on some exercise machines.

examples.en: I noticed the weight stack behind a cover while looking at the machine diagram.
examples.zh: 看器械图时，我留意到护罩后面就是「配重片组」。

examples.en: The diagram used a different color for the weight stack and the seat frame.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同颜色标出了「配重片组」和座椅框架。

collocations: a machine with a weight stack
a label on a weight stack

words.enDefinition: A pin on some gym machines that determines which weights are engaged.

examples.en: The attendant pointed to the selector pin on a diagram beside the exercise machine.
examples.zh: 值班员指给我们看器械旁的图上哪一处是「配重选择销」。

examples.en: My classmate recognized the selector pin from a picture in the gym orientation guide.
examples.zh: 同学根据健身房入门手册的图片认出了「配重选择销」。

collocations: a diagram of the selector pin
a label for the selector pin

words.enDefinition: Moveable weights, such as dumbbells, that are independent of a fixed machine.

examples.en: The floor map used a blue symbol to show where the free weights were stored.
examples.zh: 楼层图用一个蓝色符号标出了「自由重量器材」存放的位置。

examples.en: Our guide explained why the free weights were kept separate from the stationary bikes.
examples.zh: 向导解释了为什么「自由重量器材」要和固定式健身车放在不同地方。

words.enDefinition: A short, hand-held weight with a handle between its weighted ends.

examples.en: There was a single dumbbell on the shelf even though the label pictured a matching pair.
examples.zh: 虽然标签上画的是一对，架子上只有一只「哑铃」。

examples.en: The instructor pointed out the number printed at each end of the dumbbell during orientation.
examples.zh: 入门介绍时，教练指给我们看「哑铃」两端印着的数字。

words.enDefinition: A long exercise bar with weights fixed or fitted at each end.

examples.en: The barbell was illustrated separately from the loose plates on the equipment map upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼上器械图把「杠铃」和散放的配重片分开画了出来。

examples.en: My friend asked what the word barbell meant when we saw it on the sign.
examples.zh: 看到标牌时，朋友问「杠铃」指的是什么器材。

words.enDefinition: A solid weight with a curved handle above its rounded body.

examples.en: A kettlebell with a bright handle stood out from the other weights on the shelf.
examples.zh: 架子上一只提手颜色鲜亮的「壶铃」在其他重量器材中格外显眼。

examples.en: My classmate recognized the kettlebell from its shape before reading the label on the nearby shelf.
examples.zh: 同学还没看旁边架子的标签，就凭外形认出了「壶铃」。

words.enDefinition: A flat disc designed to add weight to a bar or certain machines.

examples.en: The number on the weight plate was easier to see after the attendant moved it.
examples.zh: 值班员挪动「杠铃片」之后，上面的数字更容易看清了。

examples.en: The equipment chart showed a weight plate separately from the bar and its other parts.
examples.zh: 器械图把「杠铃片」和杠铃杆及其他部件分开画了出来。

collocations: the marking on a weight plate
a weight plate with a label

words.enDefinition: A frame or stand used to store weights or keep them organized in a gym.

examples.en: I left my towel near the weight rack and went back for it after class.
examples.zh: 我把毛巾落在了「重量器材收纳架」旁，下课后又回去拿。

examples.en: I could see the weight rack from the stairs even before the rest of the equipment.
examples.zh: 从楼梯上就能看到「重量器材收纳架」，其他器械还没进入视线。

collocations: a weight rack near the door

words.enDefinition: A sturdy padded bench used as support during gym exercises involving weights.

examples.en: There was a weight bench near the wall underneath the sign for the free weights.
examples.zh: 墙边自由重量器材标牌下方有一张「力量训练凳」。

examples.en: The campus gym ordered a replacement weight bench when the old one was taken away.
examples.zh: 旧的被搬走后，校园健身房订了一张新的「力量训练凳」。

collocations: a label beside the weight bench

words.enDefinition: An exercise bench whose seat or backrest can be set at different angles.

examples.en: The adjustable bench had a separate label from the flat benches beside the mirror.
examples.zh: 「可调式训练凳」有单独的标牌，跟镜子旁的平凳分开标注。

examples.en: A photo showed the adjustable bench in two different positions near the equipment shelves.
examples.zh: 一张照片展示了器械架附近的「可调式训练凳」在两种调节状态下的样子。

collocations: an adjustable bench with a backrest
an adjustable bench on the map
a label for the adjustable bench

words.enDefinition: A gym frame with supports intended to hold a barbell at different heights.

examples.en: The new squat rack was marked on the plan beside the entrance to the weight room.
examples.zh: 「深蹲架」是新的，标在力量训练室入口旁的平面图上。

examples.en: I asked the instructor which part of the diagram showed the squat rack near the window.
examples.zh: 我问教练，图里哪一部分画的是窗边的「深蹲架」。

collocations: a squat rack in the weight room

words.enDefinition: A horizontal exercise bar suspended high enough for a person to hang from.

examples.en: The pull-up bar was mounted high on the frame at the back of the room.
examples.zh: 房间后面的架子上装着一根位置较高的「引体向上杆」。

examples.en: Our guide showed us the label for the pull-up bar on the new floor map.
examples.zh: 向导给我们指了新楼层图上「引体向上杆」的标注。

words.enDefinition: A long elastic strip or loop that provides resistance as it stretches during exercise.

examples.en: I spotted a resistance band hanging from a hook beside the storage shelves today.
examples.zh: 我今天看到储物架旁的一个挂钩上挂着一条「弹力训练带」。

examples.en: The studio had a box marked resistance band beside a smaller box for clips.
examples.zh: 团课教室有个标着「弹力训练带」的箱子，旁边的小盒子放夹子。

words.enDefinition: A firm cylinder of foam used in fitness and mobility activities.

examples.en: The foam roller was on the lowest shelf behind the pile of folded exercise mats.
examples.zh: 「泡沫轴」放在最下面一层，在那摞折好的垫子后面。

examples.en: The instructor returned the foam roller to the low shelf after the demonstration ended.
examples.zh: 示范结束后，教练把「泡沫轴」放回了低处的架子。

collocations: a foam roller on the shelf

words.enDefinition: A portable padded mat used on the floor during exercise classes or workouts.

examples.en: The studio had an exercise mat set out beside each of the blue markers.
examples.zh: 团课教室在每个蓝色标记旁都摆了一张「运动垫」。

examples.en: I rolled up my exercise mat while the instructor talked about next week's class.
examples.zh: 教练在介绍下周的课时，我把自己的「运动垫」卷了起来。

words.enDefinition: A lightweight block that provides support during yoga practice.

examples.en: A cork yoga block sat beside each mat before our introductory session began today.
examples.zh: 今天入门课开始前，每张垫子旁都放着一块软木「瑜伽砖」。

examples.en: The instructor asked which bin the class used for the blue yoga block after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，教练问大家，蓝色「瑜伽砖」平时放哪个箱子。

words.enDefinition: A raised, flat exercise platform used in some group fitness classes.

examples.en: The instructor marked a place on the floor for each step platform before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，教练在地板上标出了每块「健身踏板」的位置。

examples.en: The step platform was stored next to the mats in our campus recreation studio.
examples.zh: 我们校园文体教室的「健身踏板」放在垫子旁边。

words.enDefinition: A piece of fitness equipment consisting of a rope with a handle at each end.

examples.en: I found a jump rope in the basket labeled for equipment used in class.
examples.zh: 我在标着上课用具的筐里找到了一根「跳绳」。

examples.en: My classmate recognized her jump rope because one handle was a different color from the other.
examples.zh: 同学认出了自己的「跳绳」，因为两个手柄颜色不一样。

words.enDefinition: A weighted ball designed for exercise.

examples.en: The medicine ball had a weight label that was large enough to read from the doorway.
examples.zh: 「健身实心球」的重量标签够大，从门口就能看清。

examples.en: A classmate asked why the medicine ball was displayed separately from the larger inflatable balls.
examples.zh: 一位同学问，为什么「健身实心球」要和那些较大的充气球分开展示。

collocations: a medicine ball with a weight label

words.enDefinition: A large inflatable exercise ball used in some balance and fitness activities.

examples.en: The studio kept a stability ball in a high rack beside the storage cupboard.
examples.zh: 团课教室把一个「健身平衡球」放在储物柜旁的高架上。

examples.en: I noticed the stability ball in the diagram of equipment available for group fitness.
examples.zh: 我在团课可用器材的示意图中留意到了「健身平衡球」。

collocations: a stability ball in the studio

words.enDefinition: The control panel with information or settings for a piece of exercise equipment.

examples.en: The equipment console still showed the time from the previous session when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到时，「健身器械操作面板」上还显示着前一场的时间。

examples.en: My roommate recognized the equipment console from a picture in the introductory leaflet for students.
examples.zh: 室友从学生入门传单的图片里认出了「健身器械操作面板」。

collocations: a label on the equipment console
an equipment console with a screen

words.enDefinition: A clip that forms part of the emergency stop system on some treadmills.

examples.en: The orientation handout showed a safety clip beside a drawing of the treadmill display.
examples.zh: 入门介绍资料在跑步机屏幕的示意图旁画了一个「跑步机安全夹」。

examples.en: A student asked what the safety clip was while our group looked at the machine.
examples.zh: 我们小组看器械时，一名同学问什么是「跑步机安全夹」。

collocations: a safety clip on a treadmill
a diagram showing the safety clip
the label beside the safety clip

words.enDefinition: An organized exercise session in which an instructor leads a group.

examples.en: We tried a group fitness class after seeing it listed on the recreation center's website.
examples.zh: 我们在校园文体中心网站上看到了这门「团体健身课」，就去试了一次。

examples.en: My roommate chose a group fitness class that finished before her evening shift started.
examples.zh: 室友选了门「团体健身课」，下课后还能赶上晚班。

collocations: a group fitness class for beginners

words.enDefinition: A person who leads exercise sessions and explains what participants are doing.

examples.en: The fitness instructor introduced herself while we were waiting outside the studio that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午我们在团课教室外等候，「健身课教练」作了自我介绍。

examples.en: I asked the fitness instructor whether the session was in the same room next week.
examples.zh: 我问「健身课教练」，下周的课是否还在同一间教室。

collocations: ask the fitness instructor a question

words.enDefinition: A fitness professional who works with individual clients on exercise sessions.

examples.en: My roommate asked whether a personal trainer worked in the recreation center on Fridays.
examples.zh: 室友问，星期五文体活动中心有没有「私人健身教练」。

examples.en: The information desk explained the difference between a personal trainer and a group fitness instructor.
examples.zh: 咨询台解释了「私人健身教练」和团课教练的区别。

collocations: book a session with a personal trainer

words.enDefinition: A list of exercise classes with their times and usually their locations.

examples.en: I checked the group fitness schedule before choosing a time that worked for my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先查了「团体健身课时间表」，再选了室友方便的时间。

examples.en: The group fitness schedule showed a new room next to the Thursday evening class.
examples.zh: 「团体健身课时间表」在星期四晚课旁注明了新教室。

collocations: a change to the group fitness schedule

words.enDefinition: A class designed to be easy for newcomers to follow.

examples.en: I looked for a beginner-friendly class because I had never taken a group fitness session.
examples.zh: 我没上过团体健身课，所以找的是「适合初学者的课」。

examples.en: The instructor described it as a beginner-friendly class when we asked about the schedule.
examples.zh: 我们问起时间表时，教练说这是门「适合初学者的课」。

words.enDefinition: A class notice saying people of any experience or skill level may take part.

examples.en: The flyer said “All levels welcome” below a photo of the group fitness studio.
examples.zh: 传单在团课教室照片下方写着「各水平都可参加」。

examples.en: We saw “All levels welcome” beside the time and location for the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 下午课的时间和地点旁边写着「各水平都可参加」。

collocations: a class marked all levels welcome
a listing saying all levels welcome
a notice reading all levels welcome

words.enDefinition: A session someone attends to try an activity before deciding whether to continue.

examples.en: My flatmate took a trial class with me before we chose an evening session together.
examples.zh: 在一起选晚上那节课之前，室友陪我上了一次「体验课」。

examples.en: The trial class fit between our lectures, so several people from my course attended.
examples.zh: 「体验课」刚好安排在我们两节课之间，所以同一专业的几个人都去了。

words.enDefinition: a fitness class you can attend by the session without committing to a course, subject to availability

examples.en: I tried a drop-in fitness class because my work schedule changes from week to week.
examples.zh: 我每周的排班会变，所以试了一次「可单次参加的健身课」。

examples.en: The timetable advertised a drop-in fitness class for anyone who could come that afternoon.
examples.zh: 时间表发布了一节「可单次参加的健身课」，那天下午有空的人都可以来。

collocations: a drop-in fitness class on weekends

words.enDefinition: To reserve a place in a particular class before attending.

examples.en: I asked where to book a spot in class before inviting my roommate to join.
examples.zh: 邀请室友参加之前，我问了到哪里「预订课程名额」。

examples.en: Could you book a spot in class for yourself before we meet at the gym?
examples.zh: 我们在健身房碰头之前，你能先给自己「预订课程名额」吗？

collocations: ask how to book a spot in class
book a spot in class online
try to book a spot in class

words.enDefinition: A list of people waiting for a place if a fitness class is full.

examples.en: I joined the fitness class waitlist after noticing that every reserved place had been taken.
examples.zh: 发现可预订的名额都满了，我加入了「健身课候补名单」。

examples.en: My roommate checked the fitness class waitlist while waiting for the instructor outside the studio.
examples.zh: 室友在团课教室外等教练时，查了「健身课候补名单」。

collocations: move someone off the fitness class waitlist

words.enDefinition: A place available to someone who arrives without a reservation.

examples.en: I asked whether a walk-in spot was still open when I got to the desk.
examples.zh: 到了服务台，我问还有没有「现场报名名额」。

examples.en: The staff member found a walk-in spot for my classmate just before the session started.
examples.zh: 开课前不久，工作人员给同学找到了一个「现场报名名额」。

collocations: a walk-in spot in the afternoon class

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a class has reached its maximum number of participants.

examples.en: The booking page showed “Class at capacity” beside the session my roommate had recommended.
examples.zh: 报名页面在室友推荐的那节课旁显示「课程人数已满」。

examples.en: We saw “Class at capacity” and looked for another session on the studio timetable.
examples.zh: 我们看到「课程人数已满」，就去团课时间表找其他场次。

words.enDefinition: To tell the person leading the class that you have arrived to attend.

examples.en: The desk staff told us where to check in with the instructor when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到时，服务台工作人员告诉我们到哪里「向教练签到」。

examples.en: I had time to fill my bottle before I needed to check in with the instructor.
examples.zh: 我在需要「向教练签到」之前，还有时间把水瓶装满。

collocations: ask where to check in with the instructor
check in with the instructor at the door
wait to check in with the instructor

words.enDefinition: A notice saying that the facility supplies mats for the session.

examples.en: The class description said “Mats provided” below the location and name of the instructor.
examples.zh: 课程介绍在地点和教练姓名下方写着「提供运动垫」。

examples.en: I saw “Mats provided” on the sign before we went into the group studio.
examples.zh: 走进团课教室之前，我看到告示写着「提供运动垫」。

collocations: look for mats provided on the timetable

words.enDefinition: A question asking what level of experience a particular exercise class is intended for.

examples.en: “What level is this class?” I asked while looking at the timetable outside the studio.
examples.zh: 我看着团课教室外的时间表问「这门课是什么难度」？

examples.en: My roommate asked, “What level is this class?” after seeing several beginners at the door.
examples.zh: 室友看到门口有几位初学者后问「这门课是什么难度」？

collocations: ask what level is this class
say what level is this class
ask the instructor what level is this class

words.enDefinition: A brief pause in an activity during which people can have a drink of water.

examples.en: I asked about the afternoon schedule when our group stopped for a water break.
examples.zh: 小组停下来「喝水休息」时，我问了下午的安排。

examples.en: The instructor paused for a water break before answering the questions people had written down.
examples.zh: 教练留了时间让大家「喝水休息」，然后回答了大家写下的问题。

words.enDefinition: An instructor-led class in which participants pedal stationary bikes indoors.

examples.en: We walked past the indoor cycling class and could hear music through the studio door.
examples.zh: 我们经过「室内骑行课」时，隔着教室门听见了音乐。

examples.en: My roommate chose an indoor cycling class that started after her last lab on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 室友选了「室内骑行课」，星期三最后一堂实验课之后开课。

words.enDefinition: A class in which participants practice yoga under an instructor's guidance.

examples.en: I met a classmate at the yoga class offered in the campus activity room.
examples.zh: 我在校园活动室办的「瑜伽课」上碰见一位同学。

examples.en: The yoga class moved to another studio because the usual room needed its floor repaired.
examples.zh: 常用的教室地板要维修，「瑜伽课」就换到了另一间教室。

words.enDefinition: A class based on an exercise method emphasizing controlled movement and body awareness.

examples.en: The timetable showed a Pilates class starting just after our morning lecture finished today.
examples.zh: 时间表显示，今天上午的讲座刚结束就有一节「普拉提课」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the Pilates class used mats or equipment in the upstairs studio.
examples.zh: 室友问楼上的「普拉提课」用的是垫子还是器械。

words.enDefinition: Aerobic exercise performed in a pool, often as an organized class.

examples.en: I saw a sign for water aerobics while walking past the campus pool after class.
examples.zh: 下课经过校园泳池时，我看到一块「水中有氧操」告示。

examples.en: My roommate found water aerobics listed next to the other classes at the recreation center.
examples.zh: 室友在校园文体中心的课程列表里看到了「水中有氧操」，旁边还列着其他课程。

collocations: a pool used for water aerobics

words.enDefinition: An exercise format using dance movements, usually performed to music.

examples.en: My classmate suggested trying dance fitness after hearing the music from the studio downstairs.
examples.zh: 听到楼下教室传来的音乐后，同学提议试试「舞蹈健身」。

examples.en: The dance fitness session attracted students from several programs who had never met before.
examples.zh: 这次「舞蹈健身」课来了几个专业的同学，他们之前互不认识。

words.enDefinition: An exercise class inspired by ballet that often uses a barre for support.

examples.en: My roommate signed up for a barre class during a free hour between lectures.
examples.zh: 室友趁两节课之间空出来的一个小时报名上了「芭蕾把杆健身课」。

examples.en: The student center described the barre class in a leaflet next to the fitness timetable.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心在健身课时间表旁放了份传单，介绍「芭蕾把杆健身课」。

collocations: sign up for a barre class

words.enDefinition: A form of group aerobic exercise using a low platform, often with music.

examples.en: The student newsletter listed step aerobics among the lunchtime classes in the main building.
examples.zh: 学生简报把「有氧踏板操」列为主楼的午间课程之一。

examples.en: The room used for step aerobics was just past the large studio with mirrors.
examples.zh: 上「有氧踏板操」的房间就在有镜子的大教室过去一点。

words.enDefinition: A class where participants rotate among different exercise stations or activities.

examples.en: The circuit class was listed in the smaller studio next to the indoor track.
examples.zh: 时间表写着，「循环训练课」在室内跑道旁的小教室上。

examples.en: My classmate asked the instructor what equipment would be available for the circuit class.
examples.zh: 同学问教练，「循环训练课」会有哪些器材可用。

collocations: a circuit class with several stations

words.enDefinition: A fitness class focused on comfortable, controlled movement through a range of positions.

examples.en: The recreation center listed a mobility class under the activities offered on Tuesday afternoons.
examples.zh: 校园文体中心在星期二下午的活动中列出了「关节活动度训练课」。

examples.en: I asked about the mobility class because I had never seen it on the schedule before.
examples.zh: 我之前没在时间表上见过「关节活动度训练课」，就去问了一下。

words.enDefinition: A class focused on exercises that stretch different parts of the body.

examples.en: Our instructor moved the stretching class downstairs when the main studio was being cleaned.
examples.zh: 主教室在打扫时，教练把「拉伸课」移到了楼下。

examples.en: The campus notice said the stretching class would take place after the break for lunch.
examples.zh: 校园告示写着，「拉伸课」会在午休后上。

words.enDefinition: A class focused on activities that train the muscles to produce force.

examples.en: The timetable described the strength class as a group session with several kinds of equipment.
examples.zh: 时间表把「力量训练课」介绍为使用多种器材的团课。

examples.en: My roommate asked how to find the strength class on the recreation center's website.
examples.zh: 室友问，怎么在校园文体中心的网站上找到「力量训练课」。

collocations: a strength class in the fitness studio

words.enDefinition: An adjustment that changes how a particular exercise is performed in a class.

examples.en: The instructor mentioned an exercise modification when someone asked about the options for that activity.
examples.zh: 有人问那项活动有哪些选项时，教练提到了一个「动作替代方案」。

examples.en: My roommate wrote “exercise modification” in her notes so she could remember the phrase later.
examples.zh: 室友把「动作替代方案」记在笔记里，免得之后忘了这个说法。

words.enDefinition: An example shown by the instructor to help participants understand an activity.

examples.en: The class started with an instructor demonstration while we stood near the front of the studio.
examples.zh: 课程从「教练示范」开始，当时我们站在团课教室前面。

examples.en: I had a clear view of the instructor demonstration from the mat near the window.
examples.zh: 我坐在窗边的垫子上，能清楚看见「教练示范」。

collocations: an instructor demonstration at the front

words.enDefinition: To move or exercise in a session accompanied by music.

examples.en: My classmates chose to exercise to music in a group session after their lecture.
examples.zh: 同学们下课后选了门团课，「跟着音乐做运动」。

examples.en: I asked whether people exercise to music in the new class listed on the timetable.
examples.zh: 我问时间表上新加的那门课是不是「跟着音乐做运动」。

collocations: choose a class where people exercise to music

words.enDefinition: The way a class is arranged and the kinds of activities it includes.

examples.en: We read about the class format before deciding which session to try that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们先了解了「课程组织形式」，再决定当天下午试哪一节。

examples.en: The instructor explained the class format while everyone was still getting settled in the room.
examples.zh: 大家还在教室里安顿时，教练介绍了「课程组织形式」。

collocations: a change to the class format

words.enDefinition: An organized exercise class that is held outside.

examples.en: We saw an outdoor fitness class listed beside a map of the campus lawn.
examples.zh: 我们在校园草坪地图旁看到一节「户外健身课」的介绍。

examples.en: The outdoor fitness class met on the covered terrace when the lawn was still wet.
examples.zh: 草坪还没干，「户外健身课」在有顶棚的露台上集合。

collocations: an outdoor fitness class on the lawn

words.enDefinition: A session of planned physical exercise.

examples.en: I finished my workout just before my roommate came to meet me after class.
examples.zh: 室友下课来找我之前，我刚「锻炼完」。

examples.en: We talked about the morning workout over lunch and decided to visit again together.
examples.zh: 我们午饭时聊起上午那次「锻炼」，决定下次还一起来。

words.enDefinition: A usual pattern of exercises or exercise sessions someone follows over time.

examples.en: My roommate changed her workout routine when her semester timetable moved to the evening.
examples.zh: 这学期的课程改到晚上后，室友调整了「日常锻炼安排」。

examples.en: I wrote down my workout routine so I could remember what I had been doing lately.
examples.zh: 我记下了「日常锻炼安排」，好回想最近都做了些什么。

words.enDefinition: A notebook or digital record of exercise sessions and details about them.

examples.en: I wrote in my workout log while waiting for the bus back to campus.
examples.zh: 我等回学校的公交时，写了写「锻炼日志」。

examples.en: The workshop showed examples of a workout log that included notes about each session.
examples.zh: 工作坊展示了「锻炼日志」的例子，里面有每次运动的备注。

words.enDefinition: The total time a single exercise session lasts.

examples.en: I entered the workout duration after my roommate reminded me when we had arrived.
examples.zh: 室友提醒我我们几点到的之后，我输入了「锻炼时长」。

examples.en: The app listed workout duration separately from the notes I typed after the gym.
examples.zh: 我去完健身房输入的备注和「锻炼时长」在应用里是分开显示的。

words.enDefinition: A friend or companion who exercises with someone regularly or for a particular session.

examples.en: My workout buddy and I met at the entrance before we went in together.
examples.zh: 我和「健身搭子」在门口碰头，然后一起进去。

examples.en: I found a workout buddy through my residence hall's group chat earlier this term.
examples.zh: 这学期前段时间，我通过宿舍楼的群聊找到了一个「健身搭子」。

words.enDefinition: To find enough time for a session of exercise in a busy schedule.

examples.en: I managed to fit in a workout between my lab and an evening lecture.
examples.zh: 我在实验课和晚间讲座之间「抽空锻炼了一次」。

examples.en: My roommate hoped to fit in a workout before the recreation center closed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 室友希望在那天下午文体活动中心关门前「抽空锻炼一次」。

collocations: try to fit in a workout
fit in a workout between classes
find time to fit in a workout

words.enDefinition: To begin exercising again after a period of doing little or none.

examples.en: I wanted to get back into exercise after a busy month of deadlines and exams.
examples.zh: 忙了整整一个月赶作业和考试后，我想「重新开始锻炼」。

examples.en: My classmate decided to get back into exercise after moving closer to the campus gym.
examples.zh: 搬到离校园健身房更近的地方后，同学决定「重新开始锻炼」。

collocations: want to get back into exercise
try to get back into exercise
decide to get back into exercise

words.enDefinition: A day intentionally set aside from a usual exercise routine.

examples.en: My roommate marked a rest day in the calendar before making plans for the weekend.
examples.zh: 室友在安排周末活动前，在日历上标了一天「不安排锻炼的休息日」。

examples.en: I noted a rest day in my log when I spent Saturday at the library.
examples.zh: 星期六一整天都在图书馆，我在日志里记了个「不安排锻炼的休息日」。

collocations: mark a rest day in a log

words.enDefinition: An exercise session that mainly raises breathing and heart rate through sustained movement.

examples.en: My watch logged a cardio workout after I got back from the indoor track.
examples.zh: 我从室内跑道回来后，手表记录了「一次有氧锻炼」。

examples.en: I wrote down how the cardio workout felt while I waited for my friend.
examples.zh: 我一边等朋友，一边记下这次「有氧锻炼」的感受。

words.enDefinition: Exercise intended to develop the ability of muscles to produce force.

examples.en: My classmate asked where strength training appeared on the new group fitness schedule this term.
examples.zh: 同学问，这学期新的团课时间表上「力量训练」列在哪儿。

examples.en: The studio listed strength training separately from the classes held in the pool downstairs.
examples.zh: 团课教室把「力量训练」和楼下泳池里上的课分开列出。

collocations: a class focused on strength training

words.enDefinition: An exercise that uses the person's own body weight as its main resistance.

examples.en: The class description mentioned a bodyweight exercise as one of the activities on the schedule.
examples.zh: 课程介绍提到，其中一项活动是「自重练习」。

examples.en: I asked what bodyweight exercise meant after seeing the phrase next to several activities.
examples.zh: 我在几项活动旁看到「自重练习」这个词，就问它是什么意思。

collocations: a description of a bodyweight exercise

words.enDefinition: One complete performance of an exercise movement, counted as a unit.

examples.en: I asked what a rep meant after seeing the word in the fitness log.
examples.zh: 我在健身日志里看到 rep，问它是不是指「一次重复动作」。

examples.en: The instructor wrote rep on the board and explained how people use the term.
examples.zh: 教练在白板上写了 rep，解释日志里每「一次重复动作」怎么记。

words.enDefinition: A group of repetitions of one movement counted together before a break or another activity.

examples.en: The sample log recorded each exercise set on its own line next to a space for notes.
examples.zh: 示例日志把每「一组练习」单独列一行，旁边留了写备注的位置。

examples.en: My roommate wrote a short note after each exercise set in her new fitness journal.
examples.zh: 室友在新的健身日志里，每做完「一组练习」就记一句简短的笔记。

collocations: a pause after an exercise set

words.enDefinition: A period of rest between parts of an exercise session.

examples.en: Our sample log had a space for the rest interval between two exercise entries.
examples.zh: 示例日志里，两条练习记录之间留了一栏填写「运动间歇」。

examples.en: The instructor answered my question about a class change during the rest interval that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，教练在「运动间歇」回答了我关于课程变动的问题。

words.enDefinition: A device that records physical activity data such as steps, time, or movement.

examples.en: I checked my fitness tracker when I got back to the residence hall after walking.
examples.zh: 散步回到宿舍楼后，我看了看自己的「运动追踪设备」。

examples.en: My classmate's fitness tracker showed a different distance from the figure on the gym display.
examples.zh: 同学的「运动追踪设备」显示的距离跟健身房屏幕上的数字不一样。

words.enDefinition: The total number of steps recorded during a period or an activity.

examples.en: I checked my step count after walking around the campus track with my roommate.
examples.zh: 我跟室友绕校园跑道走完后，查了自己的「步数」。

examples.en: The app showed my step count beside the time I had spent walking indoors.
examples.zh: 应用在我室内步行时间的旁边显示了「步数」。

words.enDefinition: The time someone spends moving during an activity, excluding times when they are stopped.

examples.en: My moving time was lower than the total because we stopped to chat twice.
examples.zh: 因为我们停下来聊了两次天，我的「实际移动用时」比总用时短。

examples.en: The app listed moving time and the total time on separate lines for our walk.
examples.zh: 应用在这次步行记录里把「实际移动用时」和总用时分两行列出。

collocations: moving time in the activity summary

words.enDefinition: Minutes that an app or device counts as physical activity based on its own criteria.

examples.en: My tracker showed active minutes after I had walked back from the recreation center.
examples.zh: 我从文体活动中心走回来后，运动记录设备显示了「活动分钟数」。

examples.en: I noticed that active minutes and total exercise time appeared separately on the watch.
examples.zh: 我留意到，手表上的「活动分钟数」和锻炼总时间分开显示。

words.enDefinition: The best result a person has recorded in a particular activity.

examples.en: My roommate recorded a personal best for the walk she usually does on the indoor track.
examples.zh: 室友走完她常走的那段室内跑道，记下了「个人最好成绩」。

examples.en: I kept the screenshot because it showed the personal best from my earlier session.
examples.zh: 我留了截图，因为上面是之前那次运动的「个人最好成绩」。

words.enDefinition: How demanding a workout is in terms of the effort it requires.

examples.en: I recorded workout intensity in the notes rather than relying on the session title.
examples.zh: 我在备注里记录了「锻炼强度」，单看课程名称很难判断。

examples.en: Our instructor asked us how the workout intensity felt during the different parts of class.
examples.zh: 教练问我们，上课各个环节的「锻炼强度」感觉怎么样。

words.enDefinition: How hard physical activity feels to the person doing it.

examples.en: The fitness journal had a column for perceived exertion next to the duration of each session.
examples.zh: 健身日志在每次运动时长旁设了一栏记录「主观用力感」。

examples.en: My classmate asked what perceived exertion meant on the sample form shown in the studio.
examples.zh: 同学问团课教室展示的示例表上，「主观用力感」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Exercise that usually involves less forceful contact with the floor or another supporting surface.

examples.en: The timetable described water aerobics as low-impact exercise in the note beneath the class name.
examples.zh: 时间表在课名下面的备注中把水中有氧操列为「低冲击运动」。

examples.en: My roommate asked what low-impact exercise meant in the description of the afternoon class.
examples.zh: 室友问下午课的介绍里，「低冲击运动」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Exercise involving more forceful contact with the ground, often when landing after a jump.

examples.en: The class description said it included high-impact exercise, so I asked what the term meant.
examples.zh: 课程介绍说里面有「高冲击运动」，我就问这个词是什么意思。

examples.en: My roommate noticed the phrase high-impact exercise while comparing two sessions on the timetable.
examples.zh: 室友在时间表上对比两门课时，留意到了「高冲击运动」这个说法。

words.enDefinition: A level of physical effort that feels between light and hard.

examples.en: I wrote moderate effort in my log beside the time we spent walking indoors.
examples.zh: 我在日志里的室内步行用时旁写了「中等用力感」。

examples.en: My roommate said moderate effort was the best description of how the class felt to her.
examples.zh: 室友说，用「中等用力感」来描述那门课的感受最合适。

collocations: describe the session as moderate effort
rate an activity as moderate effort
note moderate effort in a log

words.enDefinition: To stop briefly and rest before continuing an activity.

examples.en: I went to take a breather while my roommate looked for the class schedule.
examples.zh: 室友去找课程时间表时，我去「歇了口气」。

examples.en: We decided to take a breather by the windows after walking around the track.
examples.zh: 绕跑道走完后，我们决定到窗边「歇口气」。

words.enDefinition: To begin to sweat because of physical activity.

examples.en: I didn't break a sweat during the short walk around the indoor track today.
examples.zh: 我今天在室内跑道上走了没多久，连「出汗」都没有。

examples.en: My roommate said she started to break a sweat halfway through the lunchtime class.
examples.zh: 室友说午间课上到一半，她就「开始出汗」了。

words.enDefinition: Feeling a level of tiredness that is satisfying or enjoyable.

examples.en: I felt pleasantly tired after the class while we waited outside for our friends.
examples.zh: 下课后我们在外面等朋友时，我觉得「累得挺舒服」。

examples.en: My roommate wrote pleasantly tired in her journal when she got home from the gym.
examples.zh: 室友从健身房回家后，在日志里写了「累得挺舒服」。

words.enDefinition: A day when a person feels less energetic than usual.

examples.en: I marked a low-energy day in my notes after spending the afternoon on coursework.
examples.zh: 下午一直在做课业后，我在笔记里记了「没什么精神的一天」。

examples.en: My roommate said it was a low-energy day when I asked about her gym session.
examples.zh: 我问室友那次锻炼怎么样，她说那是「没什么精神的一天」。

collocations: a workout on a low-energy day

words.enDefinition: A speed of movement that feels manageable to the person doing the activity.

examples.en: I noted a comfortable pace in my activity log after our walk on the track.
examples.zh: 在跑道走完后，我在活动日志里记下了这次「舒服的速度」。

examples.en: We found a comfortable pace on the track and carried on chatting about class.
examples.zh: 我们在跑道上找到了「舒服的速度」，接着聊起上课的事。

words.enDefinition: Describes an activity that seemed to require substantial effort or attention.

examples.en: I wrote that the class felt challenging because I was unfamiliar with the different stations.
examples.zh: 我写下这门课「感觉有挑战」，因为我还不熟悉各个训练位。

examples.en: My roommate said the session felt challenging when we compared our notes outside the studio.
examples.zh: 我们在团课教室外对笔记时，室友说这节课「感觉有挑战」。

words.enDefinition: A level of physical effort that stays fairly even as an activity continues.

examples.en: I recorded a steady effort in my log because the whole walk felt evenly paced.
examples.zh: 因为整段路都走得很均匀，我在日志里记下了「持续均匀的用力」。

examples.en: My roommate described the second half of the session as a steady effort in her notes.
examples.zh: 室友在笔记里把课程后半段记为「持续均匀的用力」。

collocations: record steady effort in a log
